home.visitSubtitle: A space of history, art and spirituality open to all.

home.quemSomosSubtitle: A community of faith that welcomes, celebrates and carries forward a mission spanning more than two centuries in the heart of the city.

vidaParoquia.heroSubtitle: Beyond the celebrations, a community that gathers, learns and serves every day of the week.
vidaParoquia.manifesto: The Basílica doesn't close its doors after Mass. Between catechesis, choir, youth groups and volunteering, there's always something happening — faith lived in community, not only in silence.
vidaParoquia.group1Desc: Catechesis for ages 6 to 16, meeting weekly on Tuesdays — through First Communion, the Profession of Faith and, from 10th grade, Confirmation preparation.
vidaParoquia.group2Desc: Singing and liturgical music at every Sunday celebration.
vidaParoquia.group3Desc: Weekly gatherings for sharing, prayer and friendship.
vidaParoquia.group4Desc: Direct service at the altar and in the proclamation of the Word.
vidaParoquia.group5Desc: Support for the Food Bank and the families the parish accompanies.
vidaParoquia.group6Desc: Moments of communal prayer, outside the celebrations.
vidaParoquia.spreadText: Retreats, pilgrimages, formation and informal gatherings — parish life extends well beyond the celebration schedule.
